question: Is power alone the instrument in the bodily activities of individual selves?
premises: Nothing other than power functions as the instrument.
Individual selves engage in bodily movement and similar activities.
inference: Power alone is stated to be the instrument even for the activities of individual selves.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the editorial marker (vi0 3|4 is unclear.
plain_english: Thus it is said that, even in the bodily movements and other activities of individual selves, power alone is the instrument.
